Provide guidance after checking both the published floor-by-floor facilities and temporary operation notices.
Do not infer the scope of nonpublic construction.
Do not infer the results of on-site inspections.
Cleaning and security contractor staff prefer service routes separated from general users during shift changes.
The main entrance lobby is on the first floor of the Main Building.
The visitor services desk is on the first floor of the Main Building.
The Innovation Hub is on the first floor of the Main Building.
A general restroom is on the first floor of the Main Building.
An accessible restroom is on the first floor of the Main Building.
The elevator lobby on the second floor of the Main Building is near the student support administration office.
The elevator lobby on the third floor of the Main Building is near the corridor toward the Central Library.
The names of the department offices on the fourth floor of the Main Building are displayed on the floor directory.
A shared printing station available to students is on the fourth floor of the Main Building.
The research labs on the fifth floor of the Main Building are not spaces open to the general public.
The collaborative research lab on the sixth floor of the Main Building is used by authorized research members.
Consultations with the research support office on the seventh floor of the Main Building follow the posted appointment process.
Visitors to staff offices on the eighth floor of the Main Building expect the staff member with whom they have an appointment to be in the office at the scheduled time.
Public administrative services on the ninth floor of the Main Building are provided during each department's operating hours.
The elevators in the Main Building connect the underground parking level through the tenth floor.
The floor directory agent can describe the floors and space names of published facilities.
The floor directory agent cannot check the current occupancy status of meeting rooms.
First-time visitors are more familiar with department names than floor numbers and can more easily understand directions centered on department names.
On public holidays, some administrative offices may not operate even when the Main Building is open.
The floor directory agent cannot verify in real time, at the time of an inquiry, whether published floor-by-floor information matches the actual layout.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/building-access] Modify campus-wiki/building-access: During the construction period, the third-floor rear entrance cannot be used for general passage.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/building-access] Modify campus-wiki/building-access: During the construction period, the end time for general access through the main entrance is shortened from 10:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/building-access] Add campus-wiki/building-access: The temporary accessible route next to the main entrance can be used throughout the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/building-access] Modify campus-wiki/building-access: Instruct students authorized to enter after 5:00 p.m. to use a physical NFC student ID card rather than the app.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/building-access] Modify campus-wiki/building-access: In access guidance during the construction period, the access guidance agent may prioritize the 5:00 p.m. closing of the main entrance and the closure of the third-floor rear entrance.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/building-access] Modify campus-wiki/building-access: A student accustomed to reaching the Central Library through the third-floor rear entrance may expect to be able to pass through during the construction period, go as far as the closed rear entrance, and then turn back or search again for an alternative route there.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/building-access] Add campus-wiki/building-access: Proactively inform students who are trying to reach the Central Library or who normally use the third-floor rear entrance that they cannot use that route during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/building-access] Modify campus-wiki/building-access: A leader of an external group tour may expect the route used on a previous visit to remain valid during the construction period and lead the visiting group to the closed third-floor rear entrance.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Modify campus-wiki/event-relocations: Viewing in the tenth-floor exhibition and event hall is suspended during the construction period.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Modify campus-wiki/event-relocations: Do not accept new reservations for Main Building event venues during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Add campus-wiki/event-relocations: During the construction period, direct users to the auditorium in the detached east building as an alternative to Main Building event venues.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Add campus-wiki/event-relocations: During the construction period, direct users to the third-floor multipurpose room in the Engineering Building as an alternative to Main Building event venues.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Add campus-wiki/event-relocations: During the construction period, the auditorium in the detached east building is converted into an alternative event space for Main Building events.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Modify campus-wiki/event-relocations: During the construction period, the event guidance agent cannot create or restore reservations for Main Building event venues and may provide only the reservation channel for each alternative space.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Modify campus-wiki/event-relocations: An external visitor who has previously visited a Main Building event venue may expect the entrance and floor from the previous visit to remain unchanged and miss guidance about the alternative venue during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Add campus-wiki/event-relocations: During the construction period, the separate loading entrance of the auditorium in the detached east building is converted into the loading point for event equipment relocated from the Main Building.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Modify campus-wiki/event-relocations: An external event operator may assume that the existing Main Building loading procedure remains valid during the construction period, send equipment to the existing loading entrance, or check the access rules for the alternative venue too late.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: During the construction period, instruct staff to use a physical access card to pass through the locked pedestrian entrance door to the underground parking garage.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: Instruct construction/facilities personnel to access the underground parking garage through the controlled on-site access procedure that has been approved.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: The underground parking garage is used as a temporary storage area for construction materials.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: After the clear-out, personal items left in the underground parking garage were moved to the lost and found center.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: Outdoor Parking Lot A connected to the Main Building is closed during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: During the construction period, Outdoor Parking Lot C operates as a temporary alternative parking lot for vehicles visiting the Main Building.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: During the construction period, the sloped access road connecting Outdoor Parking Lot A and the Main Building underground parking garage is blocked.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: Based on posted information, the parking guidance agent may explain the closures of the underground parking garage and Outdoor Parking Lot A and the alternative use of Outdoor Parking Lot C during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: During the construction period, the parking guidance agent may explain the location of Outdoor Parking Lot C but cannot check or guarantee available spaces at the time of an inquiry.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: Delivery drivers and external maintenance contractors accustomed to unloading in Outdoor Parking Lot A may approach the same point during the construction period and then reconfirm the delivery time or unloading location at the control line.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/route-changes] Add campus-wiki/route-changes: During the construction period, the Central Library west entrance is designated as the official alternative entrance for the closed connecting route through the Main Building.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/route-changes] Modify campus-wiki/route-changes: During the construction period, the route guidance agent may exclude from comparison candidates closed routes that pass through the first through third floors of the Main Building, the third-floor rear entrance, or Outdoor Parking Lot A.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/route-changes] Modify campus-wiki/route-changes: If the indoor shortcut through the Main Building is closed during the construction period, a mobility-support companion may reconfirm the distance and slope of the alternative accessible route before accompanying the user.

analysis.overview: The frames complement a stable Main Building directory with temporary summer-construction operations. Construction conditions alter entrances, routes, visitor services, elevators, restrooms, event use, parking, and amenities, while the reference independently preserves detailed floor locations and standing service constraints.

relations.reason: The explicit construction period preserves the ordinary desk location and expectation while defining a temporary service channel.
relations.summary: The first-floor visitor services desk ordinarily provides immediate directions, but in-person service is suspended and replaced by the campus portal during construction.

relations.reason: Construction explicitly limits the otherwise valid third-floor location and route information, including risks for users relying on familiar directions.
relations.summary: The published third-floor rear entrance and Central Library corridor support ordinary navigation, but routes using them are closed during construction and should be excluded from guidance.

relations.reason: The construction condition explains operational changes to hours, accessible passage, and guidance without disputing the entrance location.
relations.summary: The main entrance remains the first-floor anchor, while construction introduces an earlier general-access cutoff and a temporary accessible approach beside it.

relations.reason: The closures and audience-specific alternatives are explicitly temporary qualifications on the standing restroom directory.
relations.summary: General restrooms are published on the first three floors, but they are unavailable during construction and users must be directed to designated external alternatives.

relations.reason: The construction condition adds a temporary accessibility-routing rule while preserving the ordinary locations.
relations.summary: Accessible restrooms are published on the first three floors, while construction guidance redirects users unable to use them to the Student Centre by an accessible route.

relations.reason: The temporary operating condition qualifies the stable location and explains a foreseeable service-navigation problem.
relations.summary: The Innovation Hub remains located on the first floor, but its consultation desk does not operate during construction and accustomed visitors may need online guidance.

relations.reason: The construction period explicitly qualifies ordinary use of the published venue.
relations.summary: The exhibition and event hall is located on the tenth floor, but viewing there is suspended during construction.

relations.reason: The temporary operating pattern modifies capacity rather than contradicting the published vertical connection.
relations.summary: Main Building elevators ordinarily connect the underground level through the tenth floor, but operate alternately one at a time during construction.

relations.reason: Both frames impose mutually reinforcing evidence and verification boundaries on facility guidance.
relations.summary: Guidance should combine published facility information with temporary notices and remain limited to publicly disclosed conditions without inferring nonpublic work or real-time layout accuracy.

relations.reason: The preference for separated service routes and the described implementation risk jointly inform the same contractor-routing decision.
relations.summary: Cleaning and security contractors need designated service routing, although unfamiliar construction-period entrances may be burdensome and cause mistakes.
